roadmap.title: Playthrough 1, Chapters 1-3: Old Camp, skills and crafting
roadmap.description: Join the Old Camp, learn crafting and thief skills, collect books and finish Chapters 2 and 3. Do not sleep in beds from the start of this run.

roadmap.title: Playthrough 1, Chapters 4-6: finish the story
roadmap.description: Learn Orcish, get thrown out of the Old Camp, master weapons and the sixth circle, and finish the game.

roadmap.title: Playthrough 2: Swamp Camp and permadeath
roadmap.description: Start a new game on a permadeath difficulty and join the Swamp Camp in Chapter 1, then finish the game.

roadmap.title: Completion
roadmap.description: Relaunch the game with the Nyras Prologue demo finished to receive the final achievements.

steps.text: Play through the Chapter 2 story quests until the chapter ends.
Play through the Chapter 3 story quests until the chapter ends.
Play through the Chapter 4 story quests until the chapter ends.
Play through the Chapter 5 story quests until the chapter ends.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 6 of the story, the final chapter.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 6 until the game ends.
Follow the Chapter 5 story until you walk into the @loc{Sleeper Temple}.

achievements.summary: Learn the Orcish language to level 2.

steps.text: In Chapter 4, ask @npc{Xardas} in his tower or @npc{Ur-Shak} in the @loc{Old Citadel} to teach you Orcish.
Take the Orcish lesson again until you reach level 2.

guide.context: This is the last quest in a chain of quests about Syra in the Old Camp castle.

steps.text: In Chapter 1 or 2, finish "Bully for Bullit".
In Chapter 3, speak with the women of the @loc{Swamp Camp} to start the quest "Secrets".
In Chapter 5, finish "Escape Plan" in the @loc{Old Camp} castle. Sneak in if you have been thrown out of the camp.

achievements.summary: Complete all five "Beasts of Khorinis" book quests for Cavalorn.

guide.context: Cavalorn waits in a hut just west of the Old Camp. Each volume starts its own quest, usually killing a set number of enemies. After Volume I he asks three questions. Pick the answers about the upper spine, about amplifying calls, and about defending feeding grounds.

collectibles.name: Volume I
collectibles.method: Take the book from the hut.

collectibles.name: Volume II
collectibles.location: @loc{Old Mine} hole by @npc{Aleph}, or inside @npc{Wolf}'s house in the @loc{New Camp}
collectibles.method: Take the ladders down, then a ladder up, to avoid minecrawlers.

collectibles.name: Volume III
collectibles.location: Cave in orc territory by the two guards, or near @npc{Gilbert}
collectibles.method: Take the book from the cave.

collectibles.name: Volume IV
collectibles.method: Take the book from the shack.

collectibles.name: Volume V
collectibles.method: Take the book from the tower.

guide.context: A later volume does not appear until the earlier ones are in your hands.

collectibles.name: Volume I
collectibles.method: Take the book to start the questline.

collectibles.name: Volume II
collectibles.location: Hut by @npc{Jan}, outside the entrance of the @loc{New Camp}
collectibles.method: Take the book from the hut.

collectibles.name: Volume III
collectibles.location: @loc{Mountain Fortress}, next to a locked chest
collectibles.method: Take the book beside the chest.

collectibles.name: Volume IV
collectibles.method: Open the door next to an unlit torch, which works as the lever, and take the book.

collectibles.name: Volume V
collectibles.method: Take the book from the room.

collectibles.name: Volume VI
collectibles.method: Take the book from the basement.

guide.context: You can join only one camp per playthrough in Chapter 1, but you can still join the New Camp after the Old Camp throws you out.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, complete the tasks that make you a member of the @loc{Old Camp}.

guide.context: In the same playthrough as the Old Camp, you can join the New Camp after the Old Camp throws you out in Chapter 5.

steps.text: Join the @loc{New Camp}, either in Chapter 1 or after you are thrown out of the Old Camp.

guide.context: Joining the Swamp Camp blocks the sixth Magic Circle and other skill achievements, so do it in a separate playthrough.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, complete the tasks that make you a member of the @loc{Swamp Camp}.
Join a camp's guild and finish its rank-up quest to reach the next rank.

guide.context: Maps no longer have to be gathered in one playthrough. @npc{Fortuno} sells the second Old Mine map from Chapter 3, so it is no longer missable.

collectibles.name: Map of Swamp Camp
collectibles.method: Cast a @item{Sleep Scroll} on someone in front of him, then buy the map.
collectibles.note: @npc{Baal Orun} gives a free Sleep Scroll after you finish Swampweed Harvest.

collectibles.name: Map to the Old Mine #1
collectibles.method: Beat him up and take it from his body.

collectibles.name: Map to the Old Mine #2
collectibles.note: @npc{Cor Kalom} also hands it over in Chapter 2 as a reward in "The Minecrawler Nest".

collectibles.name: Cliff Route Map
collectibles.method: Receive it in the quest "The Focus Stone".

collectibles.name: Focus Stones Map
collectibles.method: Receive it in the quest "The Focus Stones".

collectibles.name: Drawing of the Orc Territory
collectibles.method: Receive it in the quest "A Shaman Shunned".

collectibles.name: Sketch of the Temple
collectibles.location: First skeleton room in the @loc{Sleeper Temple}
collectibles.method: Take it from under the statue.

achievements.description: Get master in all Melee Weapons
achievements.summary: Reach master level in all four melee skills.

guide.context: All four skills must be at master on the same save.

steps.text: One-Handed: train twice with @npc{Scatty} (Old Camp) or @npc{Cord} (New Camp).
Two-Handed: train twice with @npc{Thorus} (Old Camp), @npc{Lee} (New Camp) or @npc{Cor Angar} (Swamp Camp).
Fists: train twice with @npc{Jan} at the lake near the New Camp.
Orc Weapons: pass 2 trials at the fighting grounds, then learn from @npc{Chokta} in the @loc{Orc Enclave}.

achievements.description: Get master in all Ranged Weapons
achievements.summary: Reach master level in both ranged weapon skills.

guide.context: Both skills must be at master at the same time on one save.

steps.text: Bow: train twice with @npc{Cavalorn}, west of the Old Camp.
Crossbow: in Chapter 3, train twice with @npc{Scorpio} in the Old Camp.

guide.context: Only Old Camp or New Camp characters can learn the circles. The Swamp Camp cannot.

steps.text: Learn circles 1 to 5 from @npc{Corristo} (Old Camp) or @npc{Saturas} (New Camp).
In Chapter 5, get @item{Uriziel}, then learn the sixth circle from @npc{Xardas}.

achievements.summary: After the Old Camp expels you, enter its inner keep.

steps.text: After the Old Camp throws you out in Chapter 5, walk into the inner keep. You do not need to sneak.

achievements.summary: Visit @npc{Xardas}' room at the top of his tower.

guide.context: You do not need to talk to Xardas. The achievement unlocks while you are in human form.

steps.text: Get a flying transformation scroll: Bloodfly from @npc{Torrez} or @npc{Cronos}, or Harpy from @npc{Cronos} after Chapter 5.
Fly from higher ground, such as the snowy slope behind the tower, to the top room. Change back to human form once you are inside.
In Chapter 5, beat up @npc{Gomez} or finish his quest to get his key.
Use the key on the chest in his bedroom and take the Ore Armor.

achievements.description: Get all the mods for an Armor
achievements.summary: Buy every modification available for one armor.

guide.context: Any camp's armor works. Save first, because this is costly.

steps.text: Pick one armor and buy each modification offered for it.

achievements.summary: Defeat 10 enemies using only your fists.

steps.text: Unequip your weapon and punch molerats until 10 enemies are down.

achievements.summary: Transform into each of the 17 creatures.

guide.context: Buy or find all 17 scrolls first and cast them in one sitting; the unlock can be unreliable otherwise. Several scrolls can also be found in the world.

collectibles.name: Bloodfly
collectibles.note: Also in a giant log in a swamp pond north of Balor.

collectibles.name: Lizard
collectibles.location: Rocky hilltop on the orc territory border near @npc{Gilbert}

collectibles.name: Lurker
collectibles.note: Also on the balcony of the New Camp tavern.

collectibles.name: Meatbug
collectibles.note: Also in a room of the snapper tunnel before the Monastery.

collectibles.name: Molerat
collectibles.note: Also on a small riverside beach north of the Old Camp.

collectibles.name: Scavenger
collectibles.note: Also in a cave on the riverbank east of the Old Camp.

collectibles.name: Shadowbeast
collectibles.method: Open the locked chest near the Chromanin books and take the scroll.

collectibles.name: Snapper
collectibles.location: Cave after the Monastery focus stone

collectibles.name: Wolf
collectibles.note: Also in a wolf cove east of the hut by the southern lake.

collectibles.name: Fire Lizard
collectibles.note: Also west of the Mountain Fortress.

collectibles.name: Biter
collectibles.note: Also locked in a chest inside a razor cave.

collectibles.name: Razor
collectibles.note: Also in the golem room of the Old Citadel.

guide.context: Only characters carrying a pouch can be pickpocketed.

steps.text: Learn Pickpocketing from @npc{Fingers} (Old Camp) or @npc{Wedge} (New Camp).
Pickpocket 20 different characters.
Learn Lockpicking from @npc{Fingers} (Old Camp) or @npc{Wedge} (New Camp).
Pick the locks on 20 chests or doors.
Cook any food at a cooking spot.
Learn Smithing from @npc{Huno} or @npc{Stone} in the @loc{Old Camp}.
Forge 5 weapons at a forge.
Learn Alchemy from @npc{Damarok} in the @loc{Old Camp}.
Brew 10 potions.
Learn Inscription from @npc{Baal Cadar} in the @loc{Swamp Camp}.
Craft any scroll.

achievements.description: Exhaust all of Mud's dialogue options

steps.text: Meet @npc{Mud} by the @loc{Old Camp} south gate and ask him to come along.
Talk, eat, grab items, run, and so on until he repeats himself.
Beat him up; the achievement unlocks after he gets up.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy by using fall damage
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with fall damage.

guide.context: Some well-known targets, such as Okyl, have extra health, so one fall may not be enough.

steps.text: Find an enemy on high ground. @npc{Okyl} at the @loc{Free Mine} is the usual target; orcs in orc territory or snow wolves near @loc{Xardas' tower} may also work.
Knock the enemy off the ledge so it dies from the fall.
In Chapter 5, spare @npc{Gomez} instead of killing him.

achievements.description: Deal all 3 elemental damage types to the same enemy
achievements.summary: Hit a single enemy with all three elemental damage types.

steps.text: Pick one enemy and keep it alive.
Hit that enemy with each of the three elemental damage types, one after another.

achievements.description: Parry an enemy 5 times without dodging or receiving damage
achievements.summary: Parry five attacks in a row from one enemy without dodging or taking damage.

steps.text: Fight a weak bandit, such as the second guard near @npc{Cavalorn} after killing the one with the tower key, or fist-fight @npc{Jan}.
Parry five times without dodging or getting hit.

achievements.summary: Learn every lesson in the game.

guide.context: Progress carries across playthroughs, so lessons do not all have to be learned in one run. The Swamp Camp cannot learn the sixth Magic Circle, so use the Old Camp or New Camp. Do all five Beasts of Khorinis book quests too.

steps.text: Learn One-Handed, Two-Handed, Fists, Bow and Crossbow, plus Orc Weapons from @npc{Chokta} and Orcish from @npc{Xardas} or @npc{Ur-Shak}.
Learn Lockpicking and Pickpocketing from @npc{Fingers} (Old Camp) or @npc{Wedge} (New Camp).
Learn Smithing (@npc{Huno} or @npc{Stone}), Alchemy (@npc{Damarok}), Inscription (@npc{Baal Cadar}) and Rune Magic (@npc{Torrez}).
Learn Acrobatics (@npc{Buster}), Diving (@npc{Homer}), Climbing (@npc{Theron}) and the four Hunting skills (@npc{Drax} or @npc{Aidan}).
Learn all six Magic Circles from @npc{Corristo} or @npc{Saturas}, then @npc{Xardas}.

Learn the quest-given skills: Extract Secretion (@npc{Cor Angar}, "The Minecrawler Nest"), Take Ulu-Mulu (@npc{Tarrok}, "The Banner of Banners"), Take Plates (@npc{Wolf}, "The Minecrawler Armor") and Scavenger Riding (@npc{Cohsel}, "Beak Performance").
Learn Take Fins by reading "The Fire Lizard Compendium", found near the first focus stone guarded by a Fire Lizard. Learn Extract Stings by reading "The Bloodflies", sold by @npc{Wolf}.
Aim for the head with a bow or crossbow until 10 enemies have died from headshots.

guide.context: Decide before you start. It can be done on any difficulty.

steps.text: Avoid sleeping in beds for the whole playthrough; if you do sleep, plan to restart.
Finish Chapter 6.

achievements.description: Complete the game in permadeath mode
achievements.summary: Complete the game in permadeath mode.

guide.context: A custom difficulty with Novice settings plus permadeath keeps the run manageable.

steps.text: Start a new game on a difficulty with permadeath turned on.
Finish Chapter 6 without dying.

guide.context: Beasts of Khorinis and Chromanin books count.

steps.text: Read the 7 books in the little alchemy room immediately on your right when you step into the Water Mages' chambers.
Read three more books you find or buy.
Earn the other 41 achievements.

achievements.description: Get all achievements in Gothic 1 Remake and the Nyras Prologue demo.
achievements.summary: Unlock every achievement in Gothic 1 Remake and the Nyras Prologue demo.

guide.context: Download the free Nyras Prologue demo from the store page and finish its achievements. Set the game and your account to Public so Steam can see them.

steps.text: After both are done, relaunch Gothic 1 Remake to receive the achievement.
